page.layout: One column of running text, with two passages set in Syriac type at full width (the first after "SS.", the second after "B. Virginem:"); no margin notes; catchword "Ma-" at the foot right; page number at the head.

main_text.p: catio Matris benedicta, supplicatio, ac deprecatio gratia plena Beata Maria sit nobis semper alta moenia, & munitum refugium, liberet, vindicet, & custodiat animas nostras a Malo, eiusque satellitibus omnibus temporibus, & momentis. Ibidem in commemoratione SS.

Oratio, Domine, Doctorum veracium, & deprecatio Iustorum perficientium voluntatem tuam supplicet pro nobis iustitiam tuam, ut concilies nobis tranquillitatem, & pacem tuam omnibus diebus vitae nostrae. Ibidem ad B. Virginem:

page.notes: The two Syriac passages are printed in Syriac letters and I cannot read them reliably enough to transcribe them, so each line is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The first Syriac block has four lines and the second has five. The Latin "Oratio" passage is set in italic in the scan, but its first words are shown in roman type here; I left the Latin spelling as printed. The page has no running head. The "Ma-" at the foot is a catchword for the next page.
